description: This file defines the ConditionalDataBar class, which is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's ConditionalFormatting module. It manages properties related to data bar conditional formatting rules, such as visibility, color, and related conditional format value objects.

classes.name: ConditionalDataBar
classes.description: Represents a data bar in conditional formatting, encapsulating display options like show value, color, and associated value objects.

methods.name: getShowValue
methods.description: Returns whether the data bar should show its value.

methods.name: setShowValue
methods.description: Sets whether the data bar should display its value.

methods.name: getMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Retrieves the object defining the minimum value for the data bar.

methods.name: setMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the object defining the minimum value for the data bar.

methods.name: getMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Retrieves the object defining the maximum value for the data bar.

methods.name: setMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Sets the object defining the maximum value for the data bar.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Gets the color used for the data bar.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the color for the data bar.

methods.name: getConditionalFormattingRuleExt
methods.description: Retrieves the extension object for the conditional formatting rule.

methods.name: setConditionalFormattingRuleExt
methods.description: Sets the extension object for the conditional formatting rule.
